variant_perception: 产品矩阵扩张有结构性价值，但市场可能过度外推2026存储紧缺期高毛利；2027归一化盈利应低于峰值外推，除非后续证据证明持续性。

market_expectation_map.interpretation: Expectation context only; not future fact.

normalized_earnings_notes: H1扣非净利4.883bn年化约9.766bn；base 2027归一化净利10.0bn，down 6.5bn，up 13.5bn；不以H1报告净利为锚。
valuation_framework: 2027归一化净利 / 701,749,599股 × 情景P/E；非经常性公允价值收益不赋终值倍数，H股后股本已纳入。

fundamental_clock_assessment.evidence: H1 recurring earnings and storage margin jumped; MCU also grew.
fundamental_clock_assessment.risk: Storage economics coincide with shortage pricing.

expectation_clock_assessment.implication: Upside needs durability beyond raised expectations.

liquidity_clock_assessment.evidence: H-share listing changed capital base before PIT.
liquidity_clock_assessment.implication: Cash/liquidity does not replace recurring operating value.

MCU收入、毛利率及汽车/工业进展
存货、合同负债与经营现金流联动
长鑫相关采购规模、稳定性与成本
2027盈利预期修正与归一化盈利定价
monitoring_falsifiers: Storage revenue/margin fall materially while inventory rises.
Normalized recurring earnings fall below the downside scenario despite stable unit demand.
MCU/non-memory products fail to expand economically, leaving storage concentration too high.
Post-H-share capital allocation or supply dependence reduces per-share returns without offsetting advantage.

scenario_details.description: Storage prices and margins normalize faster than expected; non-memory growth cannot offset the cycle sufficiently.
Storage economics normalize from H1 peaks but remain above the prior trough while MCU and product breadth support the earnings base.
Specialty-memory tightness lasts longer and non-memory products compound, supporting high recurring earnings without relying on fair-value gains.
